structurePatterns.track: flex: 1, height: 12px (lg) / 8px (md) / 4px (sm), background: var(--bg-tertiary, rgba(0,0,0,0.1)), borderRadius: 6px (lg) / 4px (md) / 2px (sm), overflow: hidden
structurePatterns.fill: height: 100%, borderRadius: inherit, transition: width 0.3s ease, background: var(--blue)
structurePatterns.label: fontSize: 0.9rem, fontWeight: 500, color: var(--text-primary)
structurePatterns.percentage: fontSize: 1.2rem, fontWeight: 600, color: var(--text-primary), min-width: 50px, textAlign: right
